description: This source file defines the ImageDetailFragment class, which is a Fragment used within an Android application to display an image along with a loading indicator. It manages loading images asynchronously, handles user interactions such as clicks, and interacts with an activity to fetch images. The class includes methods for creating new fragment instances with specific image URLs, inflating the layout, initializing views, and handling the image loading lifecycle.

classes.name: ImageDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays an image fetched asynchronously from a URL, with a loading spinner and click handling.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImageDetailFragment with the specified image URL as an argument.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieving the image URL from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment and finds the ImageView and ProgressBar.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the image loader and click listener after activity creation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing image work and cleans up the ImageView.

methods.name: onImageLoaded
methods.description: Callback invoked when the image loading task completes; hides the loading spinner.
